description: This file provides utility functions and classes for handling, validating, and normalizing PostgreSQL database URLs, specifically tailored for use with SQLAlchemy and asyncpg. It includes a dataclass for normalized database configurations, functions for parsing URLs, removing query parameters, validating hostnames, and normalizing schemes to ensure compatibility with asyncpg requirements.

classes.name: NormalizedDatabaseConfig
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing a normalized database URL and connection arguments for use with SQLAlchemy and asyncpg.

methods.name: str|None _extract_hostname(url: str)
methods.description: Extracts the hostname component from a database URL.

methods.name: bool _looks_like_bad_hostname(hostname: str)
methods.description: Heuristic function to detect misconfigured hostname strings that are likely invalid.

methods.name: None validate_database_url_for_runtime(raw_url: str, *, dns_preflight: bool = True)
methods.description: Validates the provided database URL for correct format and DNS resolution, raising ValueError if invalid.

methods.name: str _normalize_scheme_to_asyncpg(url: str)
methods.description: Converts various PostgreSQL URL scheme prefixes to 'postgresql+asyncpg'.

methods.name: Optional[str] _pop_query_param( query_params: MutableMapping[str, str], key: str )
methods.description: Removes and returns a specific query parameter from URL query parameters.

methods.name: NormalizedDatabaseConfig normalize_asyncpg_database_url(raw_url: str)
methods.description: Main function to normalize a database URL for asyncpg compatibility, removing unsupported query params and setting connect_args for SSL based on URL parameters.
